titles: Australia Declared War On 20,000 Emus... And Lost
The Army That Lost A War To Birds
The Dumbest War In History (It's 100% Real)
description:
In 1932 the Australian army went to war against 20,000 emus... and the emus won. This is the true story of the Great Emu War: farmers, machine guns, and the birds that outran an army.

Sources: National Museum of Australia, Australian War Memorial, Wikipedia 'Emu War'.
